summary: v7.39.8 live. P-1 to P-8 done. Plan renumbered P-9 to P-19. Silence detection with SR-generated messages. Changelog dashboard. Edit profile back buttons. Next: P-19 — auto-load user after bot restart without requiring /start.
first_steps: ON FIRST LOAD: 1) Read task file at honeycombs/tasks/active/bot_update.json for full context. 2) Read this handoff fully. 3) Ask gardener for latest bot.py via GitHub API for pre-check before any patch.

how_we_work.method: Python patcher scripts — three-block PowerShell format
how_we_work.block2: Full Python patcher code (copy into opened file and save)
how_we_work.block3: py patcher_NN_name.py; Remove-Item patcher_NN_name.py; git add bot.py; git commit -m '...'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push
how_we_work.description: I generate three PowerShell blocks. Gardener copies each block, pastes into terminal, presses Enter. Block 2 is the entire patcher script. Gardener saves the file manually after pasting, then Block 3 runs it.
how_we_work.pre_check: ALWAYS request current file via GitHub API before writing patcher. NEVER assume local state.
how_we_work.post_check: After deploy, request updated file via API to confirm SHA and correctness.
how_we_work.note: Patcher scripts ONLY — no direct file editing, no regex on entire large files. Use exact string replacement with .replace() in Python.

P-12.description: Добавить repeat в модель задачи. При закрытии: +достижение, +резонанс, автосоздание новой с тем же repeat. При незакрытой — индикатор просрочки. Добавить repeat_picker как у напоминаний включая кнопку '📆 Своя дата'.

critical_rules: ⚠️ FIRST: Read honeycombs/tasks/active/bot_update.json for full task context
ALWAYS pre-check files via GitHub API before modifying — NEVER assume local state
ALWAYS use patcher scripts — never direct file replacement for >500 line files
ALWAYS three-block PowerShell format: Block 1 (New-Item), Block 2 (Python code), Block 3 (run + git)
ALWAYS post-check after deploy — request updated file via API to confirm correctness
ONE command per PowerShell block — gardener copies, pastes, presses Enter
Patch status: ✅ on success, ❌ on failure with reason — always prepend each line
Changelog: update BOT_LATEST_UPDATE on EVERY patch, keep last 5 versions, delete oldest
BOT_LATEST_UPDATE.text is a single string with \n, not multi-line
Morning brief: compact format, dedicated _morning_sent flag, timezone-aware
Achievements: counter only (achievements_count), no archive array
Silence detection: last_interaction_date in workspace, SR-generated messages, fallback templates
Never edit bot.py directly — always generate patcher script
